capabilities: Convert units inline via bracket syntax
Suggest units while typing with autosuggest
Convert units via a modal command for mobile
extras: Supports a broad built-in unit list including Swedish volume units (krm, kanna); no screenshots or troubleshooting covered in the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to convert measurement units without leaving the editor or doing math yourself.
summary: Unit converter that replaces inline [<value><source>|<target>] tokens in Markdown notes with converted values.
